给在爱尔兰取得学位的非欧洲经济区毕业生留在当地找工作的居留许可（Stamp 1G: A residence permission for non-EEA graduates who obtained a degree in Ireland to stay and look for work (Stamp 1G). Duration has two tiers by award level: Level 8 (bachelor level) is granted 12 months; Level 9 and above is granted 12 months first and may be renewed for a further 12 months, 24 months in total, but the renewal requires evidence that appropriate steps have been taken to find graduate level employment (for example attending interviews or registering with graduate recruitment platforms). Registration fee €300. There is an aggregate time cap: time as a student plus time on this programme may not exceed 7 years in total (8 years on the Level 9 renewal path).
官方资格按「非欧洲经济区国民 + 在爱尔兰取得认可机构学位」判定，未按国籍设限；: Eligibility is defined officially as a non-EEA national who obtained a degree from a recognised institution in Ireland; no nationality restriction is set, and holders of a mainland Chinese passport may apply. The threshold sits in the prior status: you must already hold a student permission (Stamp 2) in Ireland and have obtained a degree from a recognised Irish institution. People who have not studied in Ireland are not eligible.
须取得爱尔兰国家资格框架（NFQ）**Level 8 及以上**的学位。Leve: The award must be at **Level 8 or above** on the National Framework of Qualifications (NFQ). Level 8 is an honours bachelor degree; Level 9 is a master degree. The awarding body must be a recognised Irish institution, and the official list includes Trinity College Dublin, University College Dublin (UCD), Dublin City University (DCU), Technological University Dublin (TU Dublin), Maynooth University, Munster Technological University (MTU), University College Cork (UCC), University of Galway (NUI Galway), University of Limerick (UL), the Royal College of Surgeons in Ireland (RCSI), the Institutes of Technology, and awards accredited by QQI (Quality and Qualifications Ireland).
官方资格条件未单列语言考试要求（语言要求是在申请学生签证时满足的，本计划是毕业后: The official eligibility conditions set out no separate language test requirement. The language requirement is met when applying for the student visa; this programme is a post-graduation continuation and is not examined again on that point.
官方材料清单要求医疗保险与护照，未设独立存款门槛。但找工作期间的生活开销须自行覆: The official document list requires medical insurance and a passport, and sets no separate savings threshold. Living costs while looking for work must be covered from your own resources.
须已持爱尔兰学生许可（Stamp 2）并在此身份下完成学业。另有一条累计上限：学: You must already hold a student permission (Stamp 2) and have completed your studies in that status. There is also an aggregate cap: time spent on Stamp 2 as a student and time on Stamp 1G under this programme may not exceed **7 years** in total; the cap is **8 years** for those on the Level 9 and above renewal path. Official wording: `time spent on Stamp 2 as a student and on Stamp 1G under this programme cannot exceed an aggregate time of seven years in total`.
须提交最终学位的证明：学位证书（parchment），或毕业典礼尚未举行时由授予: You must present proof of the final award: the parchment, or, where the graduation ceremony has not yet taken place, an **official letter** from the awarding body confirming that the award has been achieved. Official wording: `Must present evidence of the final award being attained by way of a parchment or, in circumstances where the graduation ceremony is yet to take place, an official letter for the awarding body / institution confirming that the award has been achieved.` Note: this programme is applied for after graduating, not as a renewal while still studying.
材料清单明列医疗保险（`Medical insurance`）。: The document list expressly names medical insurance (`Medical insurance`).
官方要求申请人品行良好、未引起当局不良注意（`expected to be of: The official conditions require the applicant to be of good character and not to have come to the adverse attention of the authorities (`expected to be of good character and not to have come to the adverse attention of the authorities in any way`), and to comply with Irish law. A separate criminal record certificate is not required; the immigration authorities assess this during processing.
官方页面未设名额、抽签或年度配额的表述，属资格制：满足学位与身份条件即受理。真正: The official page contains no quota, ballot or annual cap wording; this is an eligibility-based scheme, so applications that meet the degree and status conditions are accepted. The real limits are the aggregate time cap (7 years / 8 years) and the maximum of two applications, not a number of places.

学位证书或院校官方信函: Parchment or official letter from the institution
毕业典礼已举行的交学位证书（parchment）；未举行的交授予机构出具的官方信: Submit the parchment where the graduation ceremony has already taken place; where it has not, submit an official letter from the awarding institution confirming that the award has been achieved. This is the core document of the programme.

本计划是学生许可的续接，须能证明此前持 Stamp 2 完成学业。: This programme continues from the student permission, so you must be able to show that you previously completed your studies while holding Stamp 2.
确认学位层级与院校在认可名单内: Confirm the award level and that the institution is on the recognised list
须为 NFQ Level 8 及以上，且由认可的爱尔兰机构授予（国立大学、理工大: The award must be NFQ Level 8 or above and granted by a recognised Irish institution (a national university, technological university, institute of technology, or a QQI accredited award). An overseas degree does not qualify.

在学生许可到期前注册，缴 €300: Register before the student permission expires and pay €300
备齐学位证明、护照、医疗保险，按 ISD 的注册指引预约并缴费。错过学生许可有效: Assemble the degree evidence, passport and medical insurance, then book and pay following the ISD registration instructions. Missing the student permission expiry date leaves a gap in status.

Level 8 直接给 12 个月。Level 9 及以上先给 12 个月，之后: Level 8 is granted 12 months directly. Level 9 and above is granted 12 months first, after which a further 12 months may be applied for (24 months in total).

续期不是自动的：须让移民当局相信你已采取适当步骤获得毕业生层级的工作（如参加面试: The renewal is not automatic: you must satisfy the immigration authorities that you have taken appropriate steps to obtain graduate level employment (for example attending interviews or registering with graduate recruitment platforms). A renewal with no job-search activity at all will be refused.
Level 8 为 12 个月，不可续。Level 9 及以上为先 12 个月、: 12 months at Level 8, not renewable. Level 9 and above is 12 months first, renewable for a further 12 months for 24 months in total; the renewal condition is **evidence that appropriate steps have been taken to find work** (official examples: attending interviews, registering with graduate recruitment platforms), and it does not follow automatically from meeting the status conditions. 24 months is the ceiling, not the default — Level 8 gets 12 months only.
Stamp 1G 允许持有人在爱尔兰工作（这是「找工作 + 可工作」的许可，不是: Stamp 1G allows the holder to work in Ireland (it is a permission to look for work and to work, not a pure job-search visa). The programme may be applied for a maximum of two times; time as a student plus time on this programme is capped at 7 years (8 years on the Level 9 path).
Level 8（本科）只有 12 个月，且不可续。只有 Level 9 及以上（: Level 8 (bachelor) gives 12 months only, and it is not renewable. Only Level 9 and above (master) can reach 24 months — and the second 12 months requires evidence of job search. Treating "Ireland gives graduates 2 years" as the general rule will lead bachelor graduates to misjudge their position.
累计年限上限是硬约束：Stamp 2 与 Stamp 1G 合计不得超过 7 年: The aggregate time cap is a hard constraint: Stamp 2 plus Stamp 1G may not exceed 7 years (8 years on the Level 9 path). Time spent on language school or foundation courses consumes that allowance, so the balance may already be gone by graduation.
本计划最多申请两次，且再次申请须是取得了更高层级学位（例如 Level 8 之后: The programme may be applied for a maximum of two times, and a further application must follow a higher level award (for example a Level 9 obtained after a Level 8). Repeated applications after a single degree are not permitted.
Level 9 的第二个 12 个月不是自动续：须让当局相信你在认真找工作（面试: The second 12 months at Level 9 is not an automatic renewal: you must satisfy the authorities that you are seriously looking for work (interview records, recruitment platform registrations and so on). A renewal with no job-search evidence will be refused.
与爱尔兰打工度假（WHA）的区别：WHA 是入境前的双边协议通道、中国大陆护照不: Difference from the Irish Working Holiday Agreement (WHA): the WHA is a bilateral pre-entry channel that mainland Chinese passports cannot use (it is not among the 11 partner countries/territories); this programme is a post-graduation continuation of an in-country student permission that mainland Chinese passports can use. Both are Irish, but the two channels serve entirely different groups.
